name: The Broken Construct
summary: A Windshaper asks you to tell Ayessa Dawnsinger what you learned about the broken construct. The High Order’s work with wind spirit magic has drawn concern.

sections.title: Return to Ayessa
sections.body: Take what you learned to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar. The High Order has tested the Windshapers’ patience with its experiments in wind spirit magic. It has also touched knowledge under Windshaper purview. Ayessa can decide what should happen next.

sections.title: A Troubling Name
sections.body: Ayessa believes the High Order was responsible for the construct breaking down. She knows Belathaan as Valennia Stormfist’s cousin, and says his mother was a Windshaper. His involvement leaves her disappointed. She needs time to reflect.

faq.answer: Report what you learned to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.

faq.q: Why are the Windshapers concerned about the High Order?
faq.answer: The High Order has experimented with wind spirit magic and meddled with knowledge under Windshaper purview, though it is forbidden to do so.
Ayessa believes the High Order was responsible for the construct breaking down.
Belathaan is Valennia Stormfist’s cousin, and his mother was a Windshaper.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Broken Construct
